hubs.summary: Reviewed UDOT and Utah Code sources describe intrastate motor-carrier safety requirements and vehicle registration separately from interstate FMCSA household-goods authority. No mover-specific statewide Utah HHG roster was identified in the reviewed state sources.
hubs.clock: UDOT and Utah Code reviewed 2026-10-06; Utah Code §72-9-102 effective 2026-05-06. No statewide HHG-roster data clock exists.
hubs.gap: No Utah mover-specific state roster or state HHG census is asserted. Do not substitute Utah-address FMCSA carriers. USDOT, UCR, insurance, local business requirements, vehicle registration, and federal interstate authority remain separate.

hubs.summary: Utah DOPL reports 34,341 active licensee records for its printed Contractor credential. Electrician and plumber license classes are reported separately; counts are credentials, not a deduplicated company census.
hubs.clock: DOPL count page clock: 2026-09-26 at 01:42 a.m.; retrieved 2026-10-06.
hubs.gap: Person versus business identities, license-row records, construction classifications, expiration dates and status history were not acquired. The Construction Business Registry is opt-in and is not a statewide licensed-contractor census.

hubs.summary: 2025 HMDA Utah-property county aggregates report 151,347 applications, 95,932 originations, and 24,029 denials across 29 counties. HMDA is market activity, not a lender license census.
hubs.clock: HMDA vintage 2025; county summary derived from Utah-property county rows. County sum differs from the separate LEI summary by 206 applications.
hubs.gap: Utah DFI, Utah DRE, NMLS, mortgage companies, lenders, brokers, servicers, branches, MLO people, and regulated license classes were not acquired as one roster and must remain separate.

hubs.summary: Utah Insurance Department's 2025 Health Market Report states that 1,466 commercial insurers were licensed at 2024 year end; 319 insurers reporting health business are a separate subset, not an additional population.
hubs.clock: Report published 2025; insurer status point-in-time at 2024 year end; report file retrieved 2026-10-06.
hubs.gap: Insurer company rows, agencies, producers, adjusters, surplus-lines, appointments, examinations and enforcement were not acquired as statewide rosters. No combined insurance census or complaint-as-violation inference.

hubs.summary: Utah DHHS/UGRC licensed-health-facility infrastructure contains 891 source rows. Senior-relevant observations remain separate: assisted living I and II, nursing, home health, hospice, and personal-care agencies.
hubs.clock: ArcGIS source edit time 2026-03-07; landing page identifies the February 2026 facility data snapshot.
hubs.gap: The 891 rows include unrelated healthcare classes and are not a senior-facility census. Current license status, capacity, inspections, CMS certification, and enforcement are separate and not established by this snapshot.

hubs.summary: September 17, 2026 IAPD jurisdiction feeds report 247 Utah state-IA firm CRDs (242 APPROVED, 5 CONDREST), 1,740 Utah federal notice-filing CRDs, and 90 ACTIVE ERA firm CRDs. Exact CRD overlap between state IA and notice is one; groups are not added.
hubs.clock: State and SEC IAPD compilation source date 2026-09-17; retained files examined 2026-10-06.
hubs.gap: Utah jurisdiction fields, not principal-office location, define these cohorts. IAR people, broker-dealer firms and agents, and the complete Utah securities order corpus are NOT_ACQUIRED. DFI/DRE/NMLS mortgage authority and HMDA activity are separate.
